name: codesplainer
description: Understand any codebase through small, expandable diagrams generated by your local AI coding agents (Kiro CLI, Claude Code, Codex, any ACP agent).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @codesplainer/web && npm run build -w @codesplainer/server
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w @codesplainer/web && npm run build -w @codesplainer/desktop && npm run start -w @codesplainer/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build -w @codesplainer/web && npm run dist -w @codesplainer/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add package-lock.json packages/*/package.json packages/shared/src/version.ts
